mapper.select:
SELECT id, artist_name AS artistName, artist_cover AS artistCover, introduction, gender, country, album_count AS albumCount, song_count AS songCount, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM artist
SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) <= '9'
SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) > '9' AND UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) < 'A') OR UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) > 'Z' OR COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name) IS NULL
COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name) LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
ORDER BY album_count DESC, artist_name
ORDER BY song_count DESC, artist_name
ORDER BY COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name)
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist
SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) <= '9'
SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) > '9' AND UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) < 'A') OR UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) > 'Z' OR COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name) IS NULL
COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name) LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')

SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) >= 'A' AND UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) <= 'Z' THEN UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1)) WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1, 1) <= '9' THEN '0-9' ELSE '#' END AS letter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM artist GROUP BY letter ORDER BY letter
SELECT UPPER(LEFT(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM artist GROUP BY letter ORDER BY letter
SELECT UPPER(LEFT(COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name), 1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM artist GROUP BY letter ORDER BY letter
SELECT id, artist_name AS artistName, artist_cover AS artistCover, album_count AS albumCount, song_count AS songCount FROM artist ORDER BY COALESCE(sort_artist_name, artist_name)

SELECT album.id, album.album_name AS albumName, album.album_type AS albumType, album.album_cover AS albumCover, album.introduction, album.album_year AS albumYear, album.company, album.language, album.artist_id AS artistId, album.song_count AS songCount, album.create_time AS createTime, album.update_time AS updateTime FROM album
LEFT JOIN play_count pc ON pc.item_id = album.id AND pc.item_type = 'album' AND pc.user_id = #{userId}
SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) <= '9'
(SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name), 1, 1) > 'z' OR (album.sort_album_name IS NULL AND album.album_name IS NULL))
COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name) LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
AND album.id IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_starred WHERE item_type = 'album' AND user_id = (SELECT id FROM auth_user WHERE username = #{starredUsername}))
AND album.artist_id = #{artistId}
ORDER BY COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name) ASC
ORDER BY RAND() ORDER BY album.album_year DESC NULLS LAST
ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.play_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(album.sort_album_name, album.album_name) ASC
ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.last_played_at, album.create_time) DESC
ORDER BY album.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album
SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) <= '9'
(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > 'z' OR (sort_album_name IS NULL AND album_name IS NULL))
album_name LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
AND album.id IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_starred WHERE item_type = 'album' AND user_id = (SELECT id FROM auth_user WHERE username = #{starredUsername}))
AND album.artist_id = #{artistId}

SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1)) >= 'A' AND UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1)) <= 'Z' THEN UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1)) WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) <= '9' THEN '0-9' ELSE '#' END AS letter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM album
WHERE album.id IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_starred WHERE item_type = 'album' AND user_id = (SELECT id FROM auth_user WHERE username = #{starredUsername}))
GROUP BY letter ORDER BY letter

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.sort_title, s.file_path, s.file_name, s.file_format, s.file_size, s.file_hash, s.fingerprint, s.duration, s.cover_path, s."year", s.bitrate, s.sample_rate, s.channels, s.bits_per_sample, s.language, s.album_id, s.track_number, s.disc_number, s.track_gain, s.track_peak, s.composer, s.lyricist, s.arranger, s.producer, s.extra_tags, s.create_time, s.update_time, sa.artist_id, a.artist_name, al.album_name FROM song s LEFT JOIN song_artist sa ON s.id = sa.song_id AND sa.sort_order = 0 LEFT JOIN artist a ON sa.artist_id = a.id LEFT JOIN album al ON s.album_id = al.id
LEFT JOIN play_count pc ON pc.item_id = s.id AND pc.item_type = 'song' AND pc.user_id = #{userId}
SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) <= '9'
SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) > 'z' OR s.sort_title IS NULL
s.sort_title LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM song_artist sa2 WHERE sa2.song_id = s.id AND sa2.artist_id = #{artistId})
ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.play_count, 0) DESC, s.sort_title ORDER BY s.create_time DESC ORDER BY s.sort_title, s.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song s
s.sort_title >= '0' AND s.sort_title <= '9'
s.sort_title < '0' OR (s.sort_title > '9' AND s.sort_title < 'A') OR (s.sort_title > 'Z' AND s.sort_title < 'a') OR s.sort_title > 'z' OR s.sort_title IS NULL
s.sort_title LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM song_artist sa WHERE sa.song_id = s.id AND sa.artist_id = #{artistId})

SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(sort_title, 1, 1)) >= 'A' AND UPPER(SUBSTR(sort_title, 1, 1)) <= 'Z' THEN UPPER(SUBSTR(sort_title, 1, 1)) WHEN SUBSTR(sort_title, 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(sort_title, 1, 1) <= '9' THEN '0-9' ELSE '#' END AS letter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM song WHERE sort_title IS NOT NULL GROUP BY letter ORDER BY letter

SELECT id, title, file_path, file_name, file_format, file_size, file_hash, fingerprint, duration, cover_path, "year", bitrate, sample_rate, channels, bits_per_sample, language, album_id, track_number, disc_number, track_gain, track_peak, composer, lyricist, arranger, producer, extra_tags, create_time, update_time FROM song ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT st.id AS "id", st.style_name AS "genre", st.style_image AS "image", st.description AS "description", st.song_count AS "songCount", COUNT(DISTINCT s.album_id) AS "albumCount" FROM style st LEFT JOIN song_style ss ON st.id = ss.style_id LEFT JOIN song s ON ss.song_id = s.id WHERE st.song_count > 0 GROUP BY st.id, st.style_name, st.style_image, st.description, st.song_count ORDER BY st.song_count DESC, st.style_name ASC

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.sort_title, s.file_path, s.file_name, s.file_format, s.file_size, s.file_hash, s.fingerprint, s.duration, s.cover_path, s."year", s.bitrate, s.sample_rate, s.channels, s.bits_per_sample, s.language, s.album_id, s.track_number, s.disc_number, s.track_gain, s.track_peak, s.composer, s.lyricist, s.arranger, s.producer, s.extra_tags, s.create_time, s.update_time, a.artist_name, al.album_name FROM song s INNER JOIN song_style ss ON s.id = ss.song_id INNER JOIN style st ON ss.style_id = st.id AND st.style_name = #{genre} LEFT JOIN song_artist sa ON s.id = sa.song_id AND sa.sort_order = 0 LEFT JOIN artist a ON sa.artist_id = a.id LEFT JOIN album al ON s.album_id = al.id
LEFT JOIN play_count pc ON pc.item_id = s.id AND pc.item_type = 'song' AND pc.user_id = #{userId}
SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) <= '9'
SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(s.sort_title, 1, 1) > 'z' OR s.sort_title IS NULL
s.sort_title LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.play_count, 0) DESC, s.sort_title ORDER BY s.create_time DESC ORDER BY s.sort_title, s.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song s INNER JOIN song_style ss ON s.id = ss.song_id INNER JOIN style st ON ss.style_id = st.id AND st.style_name = #{genre}
s.sort_title >= '0' AND s.sort_title <= '9'
s.sort_title < '0' OR (s.sort_title > '9' AND s.sort_title < 'A') OR (s.sort_title > 'Z' AND s.sort_title < 'a') OR s.sort_title > 'z' OR s.sort_title IS NULL
s.sort_title LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')

SELECT st.id AS "id", st.style_name AS "genre", st.style_image AS "image", st.description AS "description", st.song_count AS "songCount" FROM style st
st.song_count > 0
AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) <= '9'
AND (SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) > 'z' OR st.style_name IS NULL)
AND st.style_name LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
ORDER BY st.song_count DESC, st.style_name ASC ORDER BY st.style_name ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM style st
st.song_count > 0
AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) <= '9'
AND (SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) > 'z' OR st.style_name IS NULL)
AND st.style_name LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')

SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1)) >= 'A' AND UPPER(SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1)) <= 'Z' THEN UPPER(SUBSTR(st.style_name, 1, 1)) WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(st.style_name, ''), 1, 1) <= '9' THEN '0-9' ELSE '#' END AS "letter", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM style st WHERE st.style_name IS NOT NULL AND st.song_count > 0 GROUP BY "letter" ORDER BY "letter"
SELECT artist_id FROM song_artist WHERE song_id = #{songId} ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT style_id FROM song_style WHERE song_id = #{songId}
SELECT song_id FROM song_style WHERE style_id = #{styleId}
SELECT id FROM auth_user WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT a.id, a.artist_name AS artistName, a.artist_cover AS artistCover, a.album_count AS albumCount, a.song_count AS songCount FROM artist a INNER JOIN song_artist sa ON a.id = sa.artist_id INNER JOIN song_style ss ON sa.song_id = ss.song_id WHERE ss.style_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ss2.style_id FROM song_style ss2 INNER JOIN song_artist sa2 ON ss2.song_id = sa2.song_id WHERE sa2.artist_id = #{artistId} ) AND a.id != #{artistId} GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ss.style_id) DESC, a.song_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
